tools.name: run_employer_of
tools.description:
The legal entity that employs an employee, with its legal form, country and status.

Use when: Which company, legal entity or subsidiary employs a person, who the employer under the employment contract is, in which country. Employees only; an external person has no employer in the graph. Not for who owns the employer, and not for the unit a person works in.

Examples:
- Which legal entity employs this person? Supply the references it needs.
- In which country is the employer of this employee registered? Supply the references it needs.

person.description: The employee whose employer is asked for. An entity of class ppl:Employee: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_employer_of.person').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

entity.description: Registered name of the employing legal entity.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the legal entity.

tools.name: run_members_of_unit
tools.description:
People holding a position in a unit or in any unit below it, with the position and its unit.

Use when: Who works in a department or team, who belongs to a unit including its sub-units, headcount or staffing of a unit, who sits in which position of a unit. Lists holders of positions, so a position nobody holds does not appear; use vacant_positions for those. Not for the reporting line of one position.

Examples:
- Who works in the engineering department, including its teams? Supply the references it needs.
- Which people hold a position in this team? Supply the references it needs.

unit.description: The department or team to list; its sub-units are included. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_members_of_unit.unit').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

unit.description: The unit the position belongs to, the given one or a unit below it.

tools.name: run_missing_required_trainings
tools.description:
Trainings that the holders of positions in a unit must still complete, per person.

Use when: Which trainings are outstanding, overdue or not yet completed in a department or team, who still has to complete a required training, training gaps or compliance of a unit including its sub-units. A training is required through the role a position carries. Answers per unit, not for one person's full list of required trainings.

Examples:
- Which required trainings are still open for the people of the infrastructure department? Supply the references it needs.
- Who in this team has not completed all trainings their role requires? Supply the references it needs.

unit.description: The department or team to check; its sub-units are included. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_missing_required_trainings.unit').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

person.description: Name of the holder who has not completed the training.

position.description: Title of the position through whose role the training is required.

training.description: Title of the training that is still missing.

tools.name: run_policies_for_unit
tools.description:
Policies that bind a unit, directly or through a unit above it, with status and dates.

Use when: Which policies apply to a department or team, which rules a unit is bound by, whether a policy is in force or due for review. A policy that applies to a unit binds the units below it too, so policies of parent units are included. Not for the processes a policy governs or for the text of a policy.

Examples:
- Which policies is the finance department bound by? Supply the references it needs.
- Which policies apply to this team, including those of its department? Supply the references it needs.

unit.description: The department or team whose policies are listed. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_policies_for_unit.unit').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

effective_from.description: Date from which the policy is binding, empty for a draft.

review_due.description: Date by which the policy is to be reviewed, if set.

tools.name: run_reporting_chain
tools.description:
The positions a position reports to, up to the top, nearest first, with their current holders.

Use when: Who is the manager or boss of a position, whom a position reports to, the escalation path or chain of command up to the top of the org chart. Walks the reporting line of one position, not the people who report to it. A position nobody holds shows an empty holder.

Examples:
- Whom does this position report to, all the way up? Supply the references it needs.
- Who is the manager of this position? Supply the references it needs.

position.description: The position whose reporting line is walked. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_reporting_chain.position').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

level.description: Number of steps above the given position, 1 for its direct superior.

position.description: Title of the position at that level.

holder.description: Name of the current holder, empty when the position is vacant.

tools.name: run_required_trainings
tools.description:
Every training the given people need through the roles of their positions, and whether they did it.

Use when: Which trainings a person (or several people) needs, has completed or still lacks, through which position and role a training is required, and when it was completed. One person's full training list; for the gaps of a whole department or team use missing_required_trainings.

Examples:
- Which trainings does this employee need, and which are done? Supply the references it needs.

person.description: The people to check; repeat the parameter for several. An entity of class ppl:Person: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_required_trainings.person').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

position.description: Title of the position whose role requires it.

completed_on.description: Date the person completed the training; empty when not completed (or no date was recorded).

tools.name: run_shareholders_of
tools.description:
Who holds stakes in the given legal entities, with the percent of each stake and its date.

Use when: Who owns a legal entity or subsidiary, the shareholders and their percentages, whether a holder owns more than half (the parent company), and which stakes are recorded at all. Not for what an entity itself owns.

Examples:
- Who owns this company, and is there a parent company? Supply the references it needs.

entity.description: The legal entities whose shareholders are asked for; repeat the parameter for several. An entity of class leg:LegalEntity: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_shareholders_of.entity').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

shareholder.description: Name of the legal entity or person that holds the stake.

percent.description: Share of the capital, in percent (decimal text); more than 50 makes the holder the parent company.

since.description: Date the stake was acquired, if recorded.

tools.name: run_training_completions
tools.description:
Who completed which of the given trainings since a date.

Use when: Completion records of named trainings, certificates earned in a period.

Examples:
- Who completed the safety or the security training this year? Arguments: {"since": "2026-01-01", "titles": ["Safety", "Security"]}

titles.description: Titles of the trainings to include.

since.description: Only completions on or after this date.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_vacant_positions
tools.description:
Positions of a unit or of any unit below it that nobody holds, active or still planned.

Use when: Which positions are open, vacant or unfilled in a department or team, where hiring is needed, staffing gaps of a unit including its sub-units. Abolished positions are left out; the status column tells an open position from a planned one. Not for who holds the filled positions; use members_of_unit for that.

Examples:
- Which positions in the engineering department are currently vacant? Supply the references it needs.
- Where do we still have open positions in this team? Supply the references it needs.

unit.description: The department or team to check; its sub-units are included. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_vacant_positions.unit').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the position, active (open now) or planned.

unit.description: The unit the position belongs to, the given one or a unit below it.

tools.name: do_assign_position
tools.description:
Staff a vacant position from a date; a person joins a unit by holding one of its positions.

Use when: Someone starts in, joins, takes over or is appointed to a job, a role in the org chart or a unit; staffing a vacant position. Not for replacing the current holder: use hand_over_position.

Examples:
- The new recruiter starts as the support lead on the first of March.

person.description: Who takes over the position. An entity of class ppl:Person: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'do_assign_position.person').

position.description: The vacant position. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'do_assign_position.position').

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: do_hand_over_position
tools.description:
Replace the current holder of a position by another person, from a date.

Use when: A position that somebody holds gets a new holder: succession, a swap, a handover. Not for staffing a vacant position: use assign_position.

Examples:
- The head of the support team hands the lead position over to a colleague.

position.description: The position that changes hands. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'do_hand_over_position.position').

person.description: The new holder. An entity of class ppl:Person: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'do_hand_over_position.person').

since.description: Date the new holder takes over.

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: do_offboard_employee
tools.description:
Record that an employee has left; remove their positions and employer first.

Use when: An employee leaves the company or their employment ends. Removes the positions they hold and their employer link, then moves the employee to the state left.

Examples:
- A colleague from the sales team left the company at the end of the month.

employee.description: The employee who leaves. An entity of class ppl:Employee: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'do_offboard_employee.employee').

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail. Required for this action.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: view_legacy_unit_overview
tools.description:
The old team overview; use unit_overview.

Deprecated; use view_unit_overview.

Use when: Replaced by unit_overview; kept until the last reader has moved.

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class org:Team: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'view_legacy_unit_overview._entity').

unit.description: The unit the position belongs to, the given one or a unit below it.

items.description: In an entity view a long text cell is cut and ends in an ellipsis, so a decimal cell may not match its pattern.

tools.name: view_members_report
tools.description:
The people of one department, from the published function.

Use when: Who works in a department including its teams, as a set view with a reference parameter.

unit.description: The department to report on. An entity of class org:Department: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'view_members_report.unit').

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes, at least 1024; the view's own size, else 12288.

unit.description: The unit the position belongs to, the given one or a unit below it.

next.description: Present when more is true: pass it as _cursor, with the same other arguments, to get the next page. view.cursor_stale means a write landed in between: start again from the first page.

tools.name: view_org_catalog
tools.description:
Every unit, position and person with their keys and relations, for catalog renderers.

Use when: Render or export the organisation as a whole, one listing per kind of thing; not for one entity (use graph view REF).

since.description: Only trainings completed on or after this date.

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes, at least 1024; the view's own size, else 12288.

next.description: Present when more is true: pass it as _cursor, with the same other arguments, to get the next page. view.cursor_stale means a write landed in between: start again from the first page.

tools.name: view_position_overview
tools.description:
A position with its unit, its holder and the positions that report to it.

Use when: Who holds a position, where it sits in the org chart and who reports to it. Local relation names are accepted and stored as CURIEs.

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'view_position_overview._entity').

tools.name: view_tasks_by_state
tools.description:
The tasks in one state that are due before a day, oldest first.

Use when: Which tasks are open, in progress or done, and which are overdue.

Examples:
- Which tasks are still open this quarter? Arguments: {"before": "2026-04-01", "status": "open"}

status.description: Lifecycle state of the tasks to list.

before.description: Only tasks due before this day.

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes, at least 1024; the view's own size, else 12288.

next.description: Present when more is true: pass it as _cursor, with the same other arguments, to get the next page. view.cursor_stale means a write landed in between: start again from the first page.

tools.name: view_unit_overview
tools.description:
A unit with its cost center, its positions in a state and who holds them.

Use when: What a department or team is about: where it sits, what it costs, which positions it has in a given state and who holds them, which policies bind it.

Examples:
- Which active positions does the engineering department have? Arguments: {"status": "active"} Supply the references it needs.

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'view_unit_overview._entity').

status.description: Lifecycle state of the positions to list.

unit.description: The unit the position belongs to, the given one or a unit below it.

items.description: In an entity view a long text cell is cut and ends in an ellipsis, so a decimal cell may not match its pattern.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description:
Find the entities that go by a name, to fill a reference input of another tool.

Use when: you know the name of an entity where a tool needs a reference. Names are matched whole, ignoring case, against main, alternative and hidden names; each name gets its candidates ranked, best first, and only those of the class that the input in for takes (matches of other classes are counted in texts[].excluded). Pass the id or alias of a candidate as the reference, never a guess: when a name has several candidates, facts tell them apart.

text.description: A name, or a list of at most 50 names, each looked up on its own.

for.description: The input the entity is for, as <tool>.<input> (<tool>._entity for the entity of an entity view): only candidates of the class that input takes are listed.
